translations.web: Now the chief priests and the whole council sought witnesses against Jesus to put him to death, and found none.
translations.bsb: Now the chief priests and the whole Sanhedrin were seeking testimony against Jesus to put Him to death, but they did not find any.
translations.kjv: And the chief priests and all the council sought for witness against Jesus to put him to death; and found none.
